newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson claims more re-count victories.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson claims more re-count victories.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson & Co said Tuesday the certified results of the consent re-count conducted by the independent inspector of election appointed by Great Western Financial Corp, on consent proposals four and five, show that Ahmanson won on both proposals.

By agreement of Ahmanson and Great Western, the re-count excluded any shares that were voted twice by Great Western stockholders, and included all consents delivered through April 15, Ahmanson explained.

It said consent proposal four provides that Great Western cannot adjourn any meeting at which a quorum is present unless all business properly brought before it has been acted upon by stockholders. Proposal number five provides that the Great Western board cannot amend any by-law amendment adopted pursuant to Ahmanson's consent solicitation without the prior approval of a majority of Great Western stockholders.

On May 5, Ahmanson noted, it received certification of the consent re-count on proposal number three, in which stockholders approved a by-law amendment requiring Great Western to hold its annual meeting by May 6.
